1.consolidated_definition: art. espec. Artista, actor. Artista de variedades. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Véase performer, performero. Como performancero o performeador entre teatreros, y como chicano entre latinoamericanos, soy una voz un tanto solitaria, pero debo decirles que me siento verdaderamente en casa (Conjunto, consultado 13-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Artist, actor. Variety artist. Adapted Anglicism, infrequently used. See performer, performer. As a performer or performer among theater professionals, and as a Chicano among Latin Americans, I am a somewhat solitary voice, but I must say that I truly feel at home (Group, consulted 13-10-08)
